verdict.rationale: Vercel documents on-demand server-side compute through Fluid compute, which 'scales concurrency for AI and I/O-heavy workloads'. It also documents isolated containers and ephemeral microVM sandboxes, so it plausibly offers autoscaling instances. The evidence gives no boot-time figures and no scale figures. Missing for 10: any evidence of sub-second boot or cold-start times, documented scale limits or capacity in the tens of thousands of instances, and independent or hands-on corroboration of scaling under load.
